stories.title: Ev hayali 522 gram altınla birlikte kayboldu

en.title: Home dream vanished along with 522 grams of gold
en.summary: A father of six in Batman lost 522 grams of gold that he had saved to buy a house after giving it to a jeweler he knew for years.

stories.title: İstanbul'da tramvay, minibüse çarptı: Yaralılar var

en.title: Tram collides with minibus in Istanbul: Injuries reported
en.summary: A collision occurred in Istanbul's Güngören district when a tram struck a commercial minibus that was attempting an illegal U-turn, resulting in injuries.

stories.title: Almanya'nın en zenginleri arasında 3 Türk var

en.title: 3 Turkish nationals among Germany's richest
en.summary: Three Turkish individuals have been listed among Germany's 500 wealthiest people, including the inventors of a coronavirus vaccine.

stories.title: Güngören'de tramvay, minibüse çarptı: Yaralılar var

en.title: Tram collides with minibus in Güngören: Injuries reported
en.summary: A tram struck a commercial minibus making an illegal U-turn in Istanbul's Güngören district, with injuries sustained in the accident.

stories.title: Bit pazarından aldığı cüzdanın içinde para buldu: Asıl sürpriz sonradan ortaya çıktı

en.title: Woman finds money in wallet purchased from flea market: The real surprise came later
en.summary: A woman in the United States discovered 100 dollars inside a second-hand wallet she bought at a flea market, with an additional detail about the wallet emerging subsequently.

stories.title: Almanya'nın en zenginleri açıklandı: Listede Türk kökenli 3 isim yer aldı

en.title: Germany's richest people announced: 3 Turkish-origin names on the list
en.summary: Manager Magazin's 2026 list of Germany's wealthiest individuals and companies includes three people of Turkish origin, including BioNTech founders whose wealth declined and Auto1's founder.

stories.title: 'Türkiye'den yabancı ordulara para vaadiyle asker toplanıyor'! Hasan Öztürk'ten Akın Gürlek'e: Bu siteler neden hala açık?

en.title: 'Soldiers being recruited to foreign armies from Turkey with money promises'! Hasan Öztürk to Akın Gürlek: Why are these sites still open?
en.summary: Turkish lawmakers raised the issue of internet websites accessible from Turkey that direct citizens toward joining foreign military forces in exchange for financial incentives.

stories.title: Para vaadiyle Türkiye’den yabancı ordulara asker topluyorlar: 'Bu siteler neden hâlâ açık?'

en.title: Recruiting soldiers from Turkey to foreign armies with money promises: 'Why are these sites still open?'
en.summary: Parliamentary questions were raised regarding internet sites and accounts that recruit Turkish citizens for foreign military service by offering financial compensation.

stories.title: İstanbul'da kabus gibi cuma! Fırtına ve sağanak fena vuracak

en.title: Nightmare Friday in Istanbul! Storm and heavy rain will hit hard
en.summary: Turkey's Meteorology General Directorate issued yellow code warnings for 11 provinces including Istanbul due to expected storms and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA… Hakem Yasin Kol MHK soruşturmasında gözaltına alınmıştı! SABAH ifadesine ulaştı: Para hareketlerini böyle savundu!

en.title: BREAKING NEWS… Referee Yasin Kol was detained in MHK investigation! SABAH reached his statement: He defended money movements this way!
en.summary: A Super League referee was detained in Trabzon following a match as part of an investigation by the Match Officials Committee, facing allegations including illegal gambling and document fraud.

stories.title: Gözaltına alınan Yasin Kol'un ilk ifadesi ortaya çıktı: Sadece birkaç kişiye borç anlamında para gönderdim

en.title: Referee Yasin Kol's first statement emerges: I only sent money as loans to a few people
en.summary: A detained referee stated during police questioning that he did not engage in gambling but only provided loans to several people who had requested money from him.

stories.title: AKOM ve Meteoroloji saat verdi: İstanbul dahil 11 ilde fırtına ve kuvvetli sağanak alarmı

en.title: AKOM and Meteorology announce time: Storm and heavy rainfall alert for Istanbul and 10 other provinces
en.summary: Turkey's Meteorology General Directorate issued yellow code warnings for 11 provinces across multiple regions, with heavy rainfall and brief storms expected to cause transportation disruptions and temperature drops.

stories.title: İSTANBUL BARAJ DOLULUK ORANI... 2 Ekim İstanbul barajları son durum...

en.title: ISTANBUL DAM CAPACITY RATE... October 2 Istanbul dams current status...
en.summary: Rainfall in Istanbul continues to raise water levels in the dams. Authorities are monitoring the current status of the dams as precipitation occurs in various areas on October 2.

stories.title: Fon Koordinasyon Kurulu: Vatandaşlarımıza herhangi bir ek yük getirilmeyecek

en.title: Fund Coordination Board: No additional burden will be imposed on our citizens
en.summary: The Fund Coordination Board completed its second meeting regarding an investigation affecting over 500,000 investors. A process for repaying investor funds has begun under measures that consider additional steps in investors' favor.

stories.title: Gıda fiyatlarında alarm veren yükseliş: 2022'den beri böylesi görülmedi

en.title: Alarming rise in food prices: Nothing like this has been seen since 2022
en.summary: Global food prices accelerated upward in September, with the FAO Food Price Index reaching 136 points, its highest level since November 2022. Disruptions in shipping routes, adverse weather, and agricultural price increases drove the increase, with cereals rising 5.1 percent and sugar 6.1 percent.

stories.title: ABD’de gençler ikinci işe yöneldi: Z kuşağında oran yüzde 80’e çıktı

en.title: Young people in the US turned to second jobs: Gen Z rate reached 80 percent
en.summary: A Goldman Sachs Asset Management 2026 US retirement study shows that rising living costs are pushing workers toward additional employment. Taking second jobs has become increasingly common among young workers as a way to supplement income.

stories.title: Küresel piyasalarda tahvil alarmı: Faizler onlarca yılın zirvesinde

en.title: Global bond market alarm: Interest rates at decades-high levels
en.summary: Bond selling pressure has driven borrowing costs for governments from the US to Europe and Japan to their highest levels in decades. High inflation, large public debts, and expectations of further rate increases are affecting stock markets, mortgage lending, and currency markets.
